Subject: Mutual Action Plan: NovaHealth PoC - Next steps

Hi Jane / Tom,

Great speaking with you both today — thanks for the time. Below is a concise recap of the pain, goals, stakeholders, and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we have alignment and clear next steps. I attached a working MAP file (NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx) and the initial SOW draft for legal review.

Quick recap of pain + goals
- Pain: inconsistent latency on inference for clinical note summarization (spikes >2.5s/token during peak hours) and high per-token cost for batch workloads.
- Primary goals: 1) Reduce 95th percentile latency to <=300ms for single-request paths, 2) Reduce per-request inference cost by ~30% for nightly batch jobs, and 3) Validate data isolation & SOC2 controls for HIPAA-adjacent workloads.

Key stakeholders (from our call)
- Jane Doe (Prod Owner, NovaHealth) — decision maker for PoC acceptance
- Tom Nguyen (Engineering Manager) — technical lead for implementation
- Samantha Li (Procurement) — contract/terms owner (procurement timeline ~3–4 weeks)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Rafael Mendes (Solutions Engineer), Vivek Kulkarni (Platform SE)

Proposed MAP / milestones (working draft)
- Week 0 (by 2026-03-19): Sign non-prod SOW & NDAs — Samantha / Procurement to provide PO or signed DocuSign. (Attachment: Redwood_PoC_SOW_draft.pdf)
- Week 1 (target 2026-03-23): Technical kickoff + environment review (Redwood SEs + NovaHealth infra + Tom) — action: schedule 60m tech kickoff
- Week 2–3 (2026-03-24 to 2026-04-07): Integration & baseline benchmarking (obs: provide sample dataset & traffic profile) — Rafael & Vivek to lead
- Week 4 (by 2026-04-14): Performance tuning (batching/quantization) and cost analysis — deliver: baseline vs optimized report
- Week 6 (by 2026-04-28): Acceptance review & decision (Jane) — go/no-go for prod pilot

Decision process / acceptance criteria
- Acceptance will be based on: improved latency (95th <=300ms) OR cost reduction >=25% for nightly batch while preserving F1 >= baseline -2 points on redaction QA tests.

Actions & open items
- NovaHealth: share representative sample dataset and existing perf traces (Tom) — due 2026-03-20
- Procurement: review SOW and return redlines (Samantha) — due 2026-03-19
- Redwood: update MAP with any procurement redlines + send calendar invite for tech kickoff (Marissa/Rafael) — will send by EOW

Attachments:
- NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (working MAP)
- Redwood_PoC_SOW_draft.pdf (SOW draft for procurement)

If this looks right I’ll publish an updated MAP after we get procurement timeline confirmed and add NovaHealth’s data security contact. Proposed tech kickoff: Tue 2026-03-23 at 10:00 AM PT — does that work?

Thanks again —
